message.name: AgentCAMovementStatusAdviceV01
message.definition: Scope|This message is sent by a CSD to an issuer (or its agent) to report the status, or a change in status, of|- a global distribution status advice released by an issuer (or its agent);|- a movement instruction released by an issuer (or its agent);|- a movement cancellation request sent by the issuer (or its agent); and|- the non-settlement of the movements at the CSD.|Usage|This message is used to report the status of:|- the movements resulting from a movement instruction message, in which case, the Agent Corporate Action Movement Instruction Identification must be present;|- the movements resulting from a global distribution status advice message (with the status, authorised), in which case, the Agent Corporate Action Global Distribution Status Advice Identification must be present;|- the movement cancellation request, in which case, the Agent Corporate Action Movement Cancellation Request Identification must be present; and|- the movements resulting from an election status advice (if the status of the election advice is rejected or if the status of the election cancellation request or amendment request is accepted) in case there is a settlement problem. The Election Status Advice Identification must be present.|In the case of a failed settlement, the message contains details of the movement, such as account details, securities or cash information and the reason of the failure.|This message should not be used to provide the confirmation of the settlement; the Agent Corporate Action Movement Confirmation message should be used instead.

rules.name: DomesticOrProprietaryIdentificationSourceRule
rules.text: Either DomesticIdentificationSource or ProprietaryIdentificationSource must be present, but not both.

rules.name: DomesticOrProprietaryIdentificationSourceRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either DomesticIdentificationSource or ProprietaryIdentificationSource must be present, but not both.

rules.name: ISINOrOtherIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either ISIN or OtherIdentification must be present but not both.

rules.name: ISINOrOtherIdentificationRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either ISIN or OtherIdentification must be present but not both.

rules.name: CorporateActionIdentificationRule
rules.text: At least one element in the list (IssuerCorporateActionReference, OfficialCorporateActionReference, CorporateActionProcessingIdentifier) must be present. They may all be may be present.

rules.name: CashAmountOrSecuritiesQuantityRule
rules.text: Either CashAmount or SecuritiesQuantity must be present.

rules.name: CashAmountOrSecuritiesQuantityRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either CashAmount or SecuritiesQuantity must be present.

rules.name: StatusIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either AgentCAElectionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAGlobalDistributionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAMovementInstructionIdentification or AgentCAMovementCancellationRequestIdentification must be present.

rules.name: StatusIdentificationRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either AgentCAElectionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAGlobalDistributionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAMovementInstructionIdentification or AgentCAMovementCancellationRequestIdentification must be present.

rules.name: StatusIdentificationRuleNotBoth2
rules.text: Either AgentCAElectionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAGlobalDistributionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAMovementInstructionIdentification or AgentCAMovementCancellationRequestIdentification must be present.

rules.name: StatusIdentificationRuleNotBoth3
rules.text: Either AgentCAElectionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAGlobalDistributionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAMovementInstructionIdentification or AgentCAMovementCancellationRequestIdentification must be present.

rules.name: MovementStatusDetailsOrMovementCancellationStatusDetailsRule
rules.text: Either MovementStatusDetails or MovementCancellationStatusDetails must be present but not both.

rules.name: MovementStatusDetailsOrMovementCancellationStatusDetailsRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either MovementStatusDetails or MovementCancellationStatusDetails must be present but not both.

rules.name: MovementStatusDetailsRule
rules.text: If AgentCAElectionStatusAdviceIdentification, AgentCAGlobalDistributionStatusAdviceIdentification or AgentCAMovementInstructionIdentification is present, then MovementStatusDetails must be present.

rules.name: MovementCancellationStatusDetailsRule
rules.text: If AgentCAMovementCancellationRequestIdentification is present then MovementCancellationStatusDetails must be present.
